name: organize.v1
description: Hand-labeled messy voice dumps → expected thoughts, buckets, and tasks. Grow this set every time the organizer misfires in the demo. Labels are adjudicated by a human, optionally with a flagship model assisting.

cases.transcript: Okay so the onboarding flow, Priya's right, the drop-off is at step three, we need to cut the LinkedIn import, that's an idea for next sprint. Also I promised Arjun I'd send him the pricing deck by Thursday. And random thought — we should look at what Copilot shipped last week, might change our positioning.

Board went well, they're pushing on the enterprise tier timing. I need to ask Tushar whether we can pull the security review forward. Also note to self: the churn number they quoted, three percent, that's the good end of the SMB band, don't cite it as typical.
Remind me to approve the AppSource listing copy before Friday, and loop in Meera on the screenshots.
